Reply cards play the first line and the learner picks the reply.

lesson.title: 5.5 So do I. Neither do I.
lesson.unit_outcome: Say how much and how many, offer and order food and drinks politely, agree about likes, say what you want and need to do, talk about meals, prices and what is in your food, compare prices, use numbers to ninety-nine and ask for things at the table.
lesson.lesson_title: So do I. Neither do I.
lesson.sub_lesson_title: So do I. Neither do I.
lesson.goal: Agree with what someone likes (So do I.) and with what someone doesn't like (Neither do I.).
lesson.grammar_function: A follow-up of A1 5.5 Likes, Dislikes, and Agreement: A1 agrees with Me too. and Me neither.; A1+ 5.5 gives the forms that repeat the helping verb: So do I. after I like … and Neither do I. after I don't like …. Both are learnt as fixed replies. Each photo shows two cast members who both smile at a food or both push it away; the first line decides the reply. The pairs are Ana and Luis, Sofia and Diego, Diego and Ana, and Luis and Sofia, because Ana and Sofia share one voice, as do Luis and Diego.
lesson.prerequisite: A1 5.5 I like …, I don't like …, Me too., Me neither.; A1 5.1-5.3 strawberries, fish, coffee, milk.
lesson.speaking_outcome: Say So do I. with the stress on I, and Neither do I. as NEE-ther or NYE-ther, both fine; do not require native-like speed.
